result.topic_en: Two small tables of trial values for X and Y, giving the related quantities 12η, 12x+8ω, 12y, 12Y and 10η, 10x, 10y, 10X with sign values ε, whose sums are recorded below each table, apparently part of calculations on biquadratic residues.

methods.what: Tabulation of trial values of X with corresponding quantities 12η, 12x+8ω, 12y, 12Y and sign ε, with the ε values summed
Tabulation of trial values of Y with corresponding quantities 10η, 10x, 10y, 10X and sign ε, with the ε values summed
Sum of the ε column in the first table, with a second (parenthesised) total that appears to count only the starred rows
Sum of the ε column in the second table, with a second (parenthesised) total that appears to count only the starred row
